name: Video Brief to Production
description: When Video Production Status changes to Approved, assembles production brief (script, B-roll notes, thumbnail brief, caption variants) and dispatches thumbnail brief to Banana Pro AI.

config.description: Assemble production brief from approved record
config.code: output = { title: inputData.title, content_type: inputData.content_type, script: inputData.script, broll_notes: inputData.broll_notes, thumbnail_brief: inputData.thumbnail_brief, caption_variants: inputData.caption_variants, target_segment: inputData.target_segment, platforms: inputData.platforms, assembled_at: new Date().toISOString() };

config.description: Dispatch thumbnail brief to Banana Pro AI for visual asset generation

config.message: VIDEO IN PRODUCTION | {{step1.title}} | {{step1.content_type}} | Platforms: {{step1.platforms}} | Thumbnail brief dispatched to Banana Pro AI
